# Jamison Lahman

> Personal site of Jamison Lahman, a software engineer in Mountain View, CA with 10 years of experience across platform, backend, frontend, DevOps, and developer tooling. Mostly writes Go for developer tools these days, and maintains 100+ packages on the Arch User Repository.

Contact: [jamison@lahman.dev](mailto:jamison@lahman.dev) · [GitHub](https://github.com/jmelahman) · [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/jamison-lahman) · [X](https://x.com/jmelahman)

## Pages

- [About](https://jamison.lahman.dev/): Home page
- [Resumé](https://jamison.lahman.dev/resume/): Work history (Applied Intuition, Waymo), skills, and education; also available as a [PDF](https://jamison.lahman.dev/resume/resume.pdf)
- [Projects](https://jamison.lahman.dev/projects/): Overview of open source projects
- [Blog](https://jamison.lahman.dev/blog/): Blog post index
- [Feed](https://jamison.lahman.dev/feed/): Activity feed

## Projects

- [pkglint](https://github.com/jmelahman/pkglint): Security-focused linter for Arch Linux PKGBUILDs, built on a real bash AST; grades packages A–F
- [AUR Report Card](https://jamison.lahman.dev/pkglint/): pkglint grades for every package in the AUR and official Arch repos, with per-package pages and [JSON results](https://jamison.lahman.dev/pkglint/results.json)
- [local-preview](https://jmelahman.github.io/local-preview/): Local-first preview-deployment orchestrator; every commit becomes a servable preview at its own subdomain, with backend state following git lineage
- [Agentic Kanban](https://jmelahman.github.io/agentic-kanban/llms.txt): Kanban for AI agent sessions
- [5 Wild](https://5-wild.com/): Word-guessing roguelike where each guess is also a scored hand ([source](https://github.com/jmelahman/5-wild))
- [connections](https://github.com/jmelahman/connections): Terminal client for the NYT Connections daily puzzle
- [nature-sounds](https://github.com/jmelahman/nature-sounds): Command-line player for National Park Service nature soundscapes
- [PKGBUILDs](https://github.com/jmelahman/PKGBUILDs): Monorepo of the AUR packages I maintain, with automated upstream update PRs and CI builds
